configurationFields.label: App Download Type
configurationFields.description: Sets how to download the app. Specify the App Download Source and the relevant Git repo or GitHub release settings accordingly. Update the app after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: App Download Source
configurationFields.description: Sets the source for the App Download Type. Git repo = URL that ends in .git. GitHub release = User/Repo. Download URL = URL to a zip file. Update the app after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Git Repo Branch
configurationFields.description: If "Git repo" is selected under App Download Type, sets the branch if required. Empty = default branch

configurationFields.label: Git Repo Username
configurationFields.description: If "Git repo" is selected under App Download Type, sets the username if login is required

configurationFields.label: Git Repo Password/Token
configurationFields.description: If "Git repo" is selected under App Download Type, sets the password/token if login is required

configurationFields.label: GitHub Release Filename
configurationFields.description: If "GitHub release" is selected under App Download Type, sets the name of the zip file to download

configurationFields.label: GitHub Release Version
configurationFields.description: If "GitHub release" is selected under App Download Type, sets the release version to download. Empty = latest

configurationFields.label: .NET Release Stream
configurationFields.description: Sets the .NET release stream from which to install the latest .NET SDK version, unless a specific version is specified under .NET SDK Version. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: .NET SDK Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [.NET SDK version](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet) to install. Empty = latest version for the release stream specified under .NET Release Stream. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: App Compilation Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether and how the app is compiled. Set the App Download Location, App Compilation Arguments and App Compilation Target accordingly

configurationFields.label: App Download Location
configurationFields.description: Sets any applicable subdirectory path (under the base directory) that the app is downloaded in. This will set the working directory for compiling the app

configurationFields.label: App Compilation Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets .NET command line arguments for [building](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet-build#options) or [publishing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet-publish#options) the app

configurationFields.label: App Compilation Target
configurationFields.description: Sets the .csproj or .sln file to compile. Include any relative path from the base directory or App Download Location, if applicable

configurationFields.label: App Build Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the compiled .NET app to execute (assumed to be framework-dependent). Do not include "dotnet" in front. Include any relative path from the base directory or App Build Location, if applicable

configurationFields.label: App Build Location
configurationFields.description: Sets any applicable subdirectory path (under the base directory) that the app is built in. This will set the working directory for running the app accordingly

configurationFields.label: .NET Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets .NET [command line arguments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/dotnet#options-for-running-an-application) (not app command line arguments) to include as startup parameters for running the app

configurationFields.label: App Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Sets app command line arguments (not .NET command line arguments) to include as startup parameters for running the app

deploymentSteps.name: App Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; cd .; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $DownloadSource = \"{DOWNLOADSOURCE}\"; $DownloadBranch = \"{DOWNLOADBRANCH}\"; if (![string]::IsNullOrEmpty(\"{DOWNLOADUSERNAME}\")) { $DownloadUrl = $DownloadSource -replace \"https://\", \"https://{DOWNLOADUSERNAME}:{DOWNLOADPASSWORD}@\" } else { $DownloadUrl = \"$DownloadSource\" }; if (-Not (Test-Path app/.git)) { Write-Output \"Installing the app\"; git clone \"$DownloadUrl\" srv 1> $null; Copy-Item srv/* app/ -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item srv -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; cd app; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; git checkout --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git pull 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"App installed\" } } else { Write-Output \"Updating the app\"; cd app; git remote set-url origin \"$DownloadUrl\" 1> $null; if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($DownloadBranch)) { $DownloadBranch = (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD) -replace '.*/' }; git checkout --force $DownloadBranch 1> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git pull 1> $null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output \"App updated\" } }"

deploymentSteps.name: .NET SDK Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{DOTNETVERSION}'; Set-Location -Path '{SERVER_DIR}/'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $env:DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT='1'; $InstalledVersion =  (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --version).Trim() } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/{DOTNETRELEASE}/releases.json).\"latest-sdk\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid .NET SDK version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Sdk/$DotnetVersion/dotnet-sdk-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not GSCS. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"
